note: Ball positions hand-located on HARD frames -- ones where the detector's most confident ball candidate is below 0.35, so the ball is either absent from its proposals or buried in them. Located by eye on a 1280 px panel with a 50 px grid. These are the labels no automatic source can supply.
yield: 3 usable labels from 9 hard frames looked at: 1 frame had no ball in it, 5 had a ball that could not be confidently located even by a person looking as long as they liked.
